results.name: Mercenary Astronaut
results.description:
Mercenary Astronaut 3d model. This model was started a couple years ago for the never finished and never published another yet nonamed Indi Project. And it was staying on my hdd disk with work-in-progress condition. You know, when you start some project, and never finish it. So I thought it needed to be done. Because this model I did with big time gaps, it needs to be retextured and remodelled some parts.. I'm not satisfied yet, but I think it must be finished anyway. So I hope you like it.
It is absolutely free for your game or CG project, you can use it freely..
Textures are overweight, 4096px, and it can be decreased to the smallest one.
Model consists of some stuff and it can be turned off. Pauldrons, backpack cargo boxes, iron cargo boxes, antenna and fonar, back frame for cargo, can be disabled, for customization.
I hope you liked it!

results.name: astronaut
results.description: Hi everybody. This is my second personal job. I made this astronaut for my roblox game. I did it pretty quickly. I tried to reduce the number of polygons as much as possible. 19584 polygons, 1 UV map, texture rendering in 4k format. modeling in blender, adobe substance painter textures. I hope you enjoy it. I will be glad if you support us on artstation https://www.artstation.com/artwork/Jv4kQa
